tour.overview:
Tarangire National Park, about two hours from Arusha, is named after the river that flows through it, the only permanent water in the area during the dry season. From June to October, wildlife gathers along its banks in great numbers, including some of the largest elephant herds in East Africa. Its landscape is dotted with enormous baobab trees, and it is a paradise for birdwatchers.

This private day takes you there with a professional driver-guide in a 4x4.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 10 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Arusha
• Type: private safari with driver-guide and 4x4
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• The Tarangire river.
• Baobab woodlands.
• The Silale swamp.
• Elephant herds.

WHY THIS WORKS
Tarangire is the closest major park to Arusha and ideal for a first or last safari day.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, photographers and anyone with one day.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the crater, choose our Ngorongoro day safari.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The dry season, June to October, is best for large herds. Tsetse flies can be present; wear neutral colours, not dark blue or black.

days.name: Elephants, baobabs and the Tarangire river
days.description:
What to expect: a full day of game drives in Tarangire, with a driver-guide, private 4x4, fees and lunch.

Your driver-guide collects you at about 7:00 and drives south-west from Arusha, past Maasai settlements, to Tarangire. You follow the river, where families of elephants come down to drink and dig for water in the sandy bed, while giraffes browse among acacias and herds of zebras and wildebeest graze. Lions often rest in the shade, and leopards may lie in the trees.

The park's baobabs, swollen-trunked trees that store water and can live for over a thousand years, frame the landscape. Lunch is a picnic at a site overlooking the river valley. In the afternoon, you explore towards the Silale swamp, where buffaloes and waterbirds gather, and look for colourful birds such as lilac-breasted rollers and yellow-collared lovebirds, before returning to Arusha.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
07:00 – Pick-up in Arusha.
09:00 – Enter Tarangire.
09:15 – Game drive along the river.
12:30 – Picnic lunch.
13:30 – Afternoon game drive.
16:00 – Leave the park.
18:00 – Back in Arusha.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Wear neutral colours to avoid tsetse flies.
• An overnight in a tented camp can be added.

INCLUDED: private 4x4 and driver-guide, park fees, picnic lunch, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: When is Tarangire best?
faq.answer: June to October, the dry season, when animals gather at the river.

faq.question: Will we see elephants?
faq.answer: Almost certainly; Tarangire has large herds.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child seats are available on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Yes, as it is entirely by vehicle.

faq.question: Are there tsetse flies?
faq.answer: In some areas; wear neutral colours and repellent.

faq.question: Can we stay overnight?
faq.answer: Yes, in a tented camp inside or near the park.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Neutral-coloured light clothes, a hat and sun protection.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary on safari in Tanzania: guides, drivers and camp staff appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice. Your guide can suggest typical amounts.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
